current.text: Memphis projects him as a starter. The projected starting five is Ty Jerome, Cedric Coward, Jerami Grant, Cameron Boozer and Zach Edey.
Experts expect him to start and play about 28 minutes, with more shots and more free throws in a standard second-year jump.
Experts pick him as a second-year breakout, with a usage bump and room for his assists to grow.
Ja Morant is gone. That leaves little usage competition in Memphis, and Cameron Boozer is the other main usage option.
His Yahoo ADP of 87 and rank of 84 are fair. He is better value on ESPN (around 124) and Fantrax (107). The expert is happy to take him in the 90s.
In an auction mock draft, Josh valued him at about 6 USD.

Coach Tuomas Iisalo uses short, hard stints, plays at a very high pace and runs a deep rotation of 11 or 12 players. That can cap minutes, but Joe expects Coward to be one of only two Grizzlies above 30 minutes.
Memphis has a maxed 4-4-4 schedule in our playoff weeks (season ending March 28) and only 13 back-to-backs, possibly the fewest in the league.

durable.text: He does not produce many steals or blocks, and his defensive stats did not come as a rookie.

Experts disagree on his rebounding. Joe calls him a rebounding shooting guard, while the newest preview calls him a middling rebounder. The projections rate his rebounds well above other guards and forwards.
He is a third-option scorer who knocks down open shots, and he is a strong real-life defender.
He has a good archetype but is old for a second-year player, and he has not yet shown he can raise his usage or shot volume.

note: Nobody drafted him in our league last season. Yahoo values him at 13 USD but his average Yahoo cost is only 3.7 USD, and Josh priced him at about 6 USD. That makes him a good target around 4 to 8 USD as a starter on a 4-4-4 playoff schedule with few back-to-backs. His projection has no weak category, with a good FT% (84.7%) and strong rebounds for his position, so he fits any build, but do not expect steals or blocks. Early in the season, check that he plays near 28 to 30 minutes in Iisalo's deep rotation and that his shot volume rises from 10.5 attempts toward Yahoo's 14.2.
